crossRefs.note: The portion of Jacob is not like these, for he is the former of all things; including the tribe of his inheritance…
Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
“Yahweh is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
God has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding has he…
Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.
I form the light and create darkness. I make peace and create calamity. I am Yahweh, who does all these things.
Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice, and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among…
For Yahweh’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance…
For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.
I was angry with my people. I profaned my inheritance and gave them into your hand. You showed them no mercy. You laid…
Yahweh, who gives the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, who…
You show loving kindness to thousands, and repay the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after…
Their Redeemer is strong: Yahweh of Armies is his name. He will thoroughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to…
Our Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies is his name, is the Holy One of Israel.
For I am Yahweh your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar. Yahweh of Armies is his name.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the maker of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance: Yahweh of Armies is his name.
translations.bsb: The Portion of Jacob is not like these, for He is the Maker of all things, and Israel is the tribe of His inheritance— the LORD of Hosts is His name.
translations.kjv: The portion of Jacob is not like them: for he is the former of all things; and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: The LORD of hosts is his name.
translations.asv: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the former of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance: Jehovah of hosts is his name.
